searchText: Is there a way to quickly fetch all the block header of the beacon chain, I would like to check stats on sync participation? You'd have to poll for each slot, for example: ``` for slot in $(seq 2375680 3573780); do curl -s localhost:5052/eth/v2/beacon/blocks/${slot}|jq -r .data.message.body.sync_aggregate.sync_committee_bits; done ``` Is there any public api nodes? infura has free level accounts... can do a reasonable number of requests per day from mem For some reason all the requests from https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/#/ using http://public-mainnet-node.ethereum.org/ are failing Thanks I will check it the html renders with listed issues but i havent dug into it.. i think theres a block of listed issues at the bottom of the main page to oh thats just that it cant download the v2.2.0 release apparently my last pr was clean (#202) What is the slot/ epoch since when the altair upgrade was made (so slots since the sync committee was added)? ahm... i can find the slot number of altair - its in config... `2375680` is the first Altair slot https://cointelegraph.com/news/ethereum-2-0-inches-closer-with-the-beacon-chain-s-altair-upgrade google found that with date, i have no idea as to the rest of the article heh Thanks <@!144468805697929216> and <@!680234424037670912>

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: Is there a way to quickly fetch all the block header of the beacon chain, I would like to check stats on sync participation?

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content:
You'd have to poll for each slot, for example:

```
for slot in $(seq 2375680 3573780); do curl -s localhost:5052/eth/v2/beacon/blocks/${slot}|jq -r .data.message.body.sync_aggregate.sync_committee_bits; done
```
